name: Nicotinamide riboside chloride
description: Nicotinamide riboside chloride (CAS 23111-00-4 ), commonly abbreviated as NR-Cl, is the chloride salt form of nicotinamide riboside. It is a bioavailable precursor to NAD+ used across nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic manufacturing. It functions as a cellular coenzyme precursor, supporting NAD+ biosynthesis in finished formulations targeting metabolic and longevity-related applications. In dietary supplements, it is the active ingredient in NAD+ precursor capsules. NR-Cl is also utilized in tablets and powdered drink formats marketed for energy metabolism and healthy aging. Pharmaceutical manufacturers incorporate it into formulations where precise NAD+ pathway modulation is required. In cosmetic and personal care formulations, it is used in anti-aging serums and topical treatments. This NAD+ precursor activity supports skin cell renewal and moisture retention in high-end skincare products. Sports nutrition and wellness brands also use NR-Cl in premium blend powders targeting cellular energy and recovery claims. It is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder for various industrial uses. It is available in pharmaceutical-grade and food-grade specifications, with USP and FCC grades recognized in commercial supply chains. These standards ensure high purity for sensitive manufacturing processes. Packaging typically ranges from small research quantities up to bulk kilogram lots to serve both development-scale and commercial production needs.
